title: 第五章 图书馆禁书区的徽光第六章 空间感知者的秘密
lines: 第五章：图书馆禁书区徽光
幻境学院的图书馆像一头蛰伏的巨兽，盘踞在校园西侧的坡地上。哥特式尖顶刺破斯卡市的晨雾，彩色玻璃窗将阳光折射成流动的魔法光斑，落在刻满古老符文的橡木大门上。新生们被告知，这里藏着幻灵国最完整的魔法典籍，但三楼东侧的“禁书区”是绝对的禁地——据说那里封存着会侵蚀心智的禁忌魔法，只有持有导师特制徽章的人才能踏入。
林澈站在图书馆二楼的回廊上，指尖无意识地摩挲着袖口。半小时前，他在元素课上又一次“看”到了不该存在的东西——当导师演示水元素凝聚时，他的视野边缘突然泛起一层淡紫色的涟漪，顺着涟漪望去，讲台后方的墙壁竟像透明的水幕般波动，露出墙后一闪而过的、布满星图的暗室。
“又走神了？”苏璃的声音从旁边传来，她抱着一本《植物与魔法共鸣原理》，浅绿色的裙摆沾了点草屑，“刚才导师说，下周要进行基础元素操控考核，不合格的话，连进入图书馆三楼的资格都没有哦。”
林澈回过神，看向这位来自灵都国的少女。苏璃的家族是灵都国著名的“自然魔法师”，据说能听懂植物的语言，她手腕上戴着一串由藤蔓编织的手链，那是她与家族契约植物的信物。“没什么，”林澈含糊道，“只是觉得……这图书馆有点奇怪。”
“奇怪？”苏璃眨了眨眼，“是说这里的书会自己移动吗？我昨天看到一本《上古草药图鉴》从书架上跳下来，钻进了角落里的盆栽里呢。”
林澈没接话。他的“空间感知”天赋是三天前觉醒的，就在入学测试时。当时负责测试的导师用魔法构建了一个复杂的空间迷宫，所有人都被困在其中，唯有林澈能“看到”迷宫墙壁间流动的空间缝隙，顺着缝隙走，竟比最快的学生还早十分钟走出。事后导师单独找他谈话，只说这天赋“罕见且危险”，让他暂时不要声张。
此刻，那股熟悉的波动又出现了。这次不是来自墙壁，而是来自三楼东侧的方向——禁书区。
“我去趟三楼，找本关于空间魔法基础的书。”林澈对苏璃说。
“三楼？可是我们新生只能在一、二楼活动啊。”苏璃有些担忧，“而且东侧是禁书区，听说有魔法屏障封锁呢。”
“只是在门口看看，不进去。”林澈笑了笑，转身走向通往三楼的楼梯。
三楼的光线明显暗了许多，空气中弥漫着旧书页和某种金属锈蚀的味道。走廊两侧的书架更高，上面的书籍封面大多没有文字，只有晦涩的符号。越往东走，空气越发凝滞，仿佛有一层无形的薄膜挡在前方。
林澈停下脚步。前方五米处，走廊尽头的墙壁与其他地方不同——那里的砖石颜色更深，隐约能看到墙面上刻着一个巨大的徽章图案：由星辰、权杖和锁链组成的三角徽记，正是幻境学院的校徽，但徽记的中心是空的，像是缺失了什么。
就是这里了。
他能“看到”那层无形的屏障——并非实体，而是由无数细密的空间褶皱组成，像一张绷紧的网，任何试图强行穿过的物体都会被褶皱撕裂。但此刻，那屏障的中心，也就是徽章图案的正中央，正有一点微弱的蓝光在闪烁，如同溺水者在水面发出的求救信号。
那光芒很奇特，既不属于元素魔法的任何一种，也不像是幻术制造的幻影。它在缓慢地、有节奏地跳动，仿佛某种呼吸。
林澈试着伸出手，指尖刚要触碰到屏障，突然听到身后传来脚步声。
“新生？这里不是你该来的地方。”
一个清冷的女声响起。林澈回头，看到一个穿着镜幻国服饰的少女站在不远处。她的头发是极浅的银色，眼眸是剔透的冰蓝色，手里抱着一本封面光滑如镜的书。是月姬，那个据说能从镜子里看到未来碎片的孤女。
“只是路过。”林澈收回手，不动声色地后退半步。
月姬却没走，她的目光越过林澈，落在禁书区的墙壁上，冰蓝色的瞳孔微微收缩。“你也看到了？”她轻声问。
“看到什么？”
“光。”月姬的声音压得很低，“墙里面的光。”
林澈心头一震。他本以为这“空间感知”是自己独有的，没想到月姬也能看到。
“你能看到？”
月姬点点头，走到他身边，视线紧盯着墙壁上的徽章图案。“镜幻国的古籍里记载过，幻境学院的禁书区封印着‘门’，而开启门的钥匙，就藏在校徽缺失的中心。”她抬手，指尖在空中虚画了一个与墙上徽章相同的图案，“我昨晚在宿舍的镜子里看到过这里的画面，和现在一模一样——除了那点光。”
“镜子里的画面？”
“嗯，”月姬的睫毛颤了颤，“画面里，这面墙是打开的，里面是一条旋转的楼梯，楼梯尽头有个发光的盒子。但画面很模糊，还夹杂着……火焰燃烧的声音。”
火焰？林澈立刻想到了那个总爱跟人比试火系魔法的魔法国少年凯。昨天在开学典礼上，凯为了展示实力，差点用火焰点燃了学院的旗帜，被导师训斥了一顿。
就在这时，那点蓝光突然变亮了一瞬，屏障上的空间褶皱剧烈波动起来，像是被什么东西撞击了一下。林澈的额头传来一阵刺痛，他仿佛“看到”屏障后方的空间在扭曲，有什么巨大的、带着灼热气息的东西正在试图冲破封印。
一声闷响从墙后传来，紧接着是书页散落的哗啦声。三楼走廊里的魔法灯剧烈闪烁了几下，光线忽明忽暗。

Chapter 5: Huiguang, the restricted book area of the library
The library of Fantasy College is like a dormant giant beast, entrenched on the slope on the west side of the campus. The Gothic spiers pierce the morning fog in Ska City, and the stained glass windows refract the sunlight into flowing magical light spots, which fall on the oak door engraved with ancient runes. The freshmen were told that the most complete magic book in the Phantom Kingdom is hidden here, but the "Forbidden Book Area" on the east side of the third floor is an absolutely forbidden area - it is said that forbidden magic that can corrode the mind is sealed there, and only those with a special badge made by their mentor can enter.
Lin Che stood in the corridor on the second floor of the library, her fingertips unconsciously rubbing her sleeves. Half an hour ago, he once again "saw" something that shouldn't exist in the element class - when the instructor demonstrated the condensation of water elements, a layer of lavender ripples suddenly appeared at the edge of his vision. Looking along the ripples, the wall behind the podium actually fluctuated like a transparent water curtain, revealing a dark room full of star maps that flashed behind the wall.
"Are you distracted again?" Su Li's voice came from the side. She was holding a copy of "Principles of Resonance between Plants and Magic", and her light green skirt was stained with grass clippings. "The instructor just said that there will be a basic element manipulation assessment next week. If you fail, you will not even be qualified to enter the third floor of the library."
Lin Che came back to her senses and looked at the girl from Lingdu Kingdom. Su Li's family is a famous "natural magician" in Lingdu Kingdom. It is said that she can understand the language of plants. She wears a bracelet woven from vines on her wrist, which is a token of the plant contract between her and her family. "It's nothing," Lin Che said vaguely, "I just think... this library is a bit strange."
"Strange?" Su Li blinked, "Do you mean the books here can move on their own? Yesterday I saw an "Illustrated Book of Ancient Herbal Medicine" jumping off the bookshelf and getting into the potted plant in the corner."
Lin Che didn't answer. His "spatial perception" talent was awakened three days ago, during the entrance test. The instructor in charge of the test at that time used magic to build a complex space maze, and everyone was trapped in it. Only Lin Che could "see" the space gaps flowing between the walls of the maze. By walking along the gaps, she walked out ten minutes earlier than the fastest student. Afterwards, his mentor talked to him alone. He only said that this talent was "rare and dangerous" and asked him to keep quiet for the time being.
At this moment, that familiar wave appeared again. This time it didn't come from the wall, but from the east side of the third floor - the restricted book area.
"I'm going to the third floor to find a book on the basics of space magic." Lin Che said to Su Li.
"Third floor? But we freshmen can only move around on the first and second floors." Su Li was a little worried, "And the east side is the forbidden book area. I heard there is a magic barrier to block it."
"Just looking at the door, not going in." Lin Che smiled, turned and walked towards the stairs leading to the third floor.
The light on the third floor was obviously much darker, and the air was filled with the smell of old book pages and some kind of metal rust. The bookshelves on both sides of the corridor are taller, and most of the book covers on them have no text, only obscure symbols. The further east you go, the more stagnant the air becomes, as if there is an invisible film blocking the way.
Lin Che stopped. Five meters ahead, the wall at the end of the corridor is different from other places - the bricks there are darker in color, and a huge emblem pattern can be vaguely seen engraved on the wall: a triangular emblem composed of stars, scepters and chains, which is the school emblem of Fantasy Academy, but the center of the emblem is empty, as if something is missing.
This is it.
He could "see" the invisible barrier - not an entity, but composed of countless fine spatial folds, like a tight net, and any object that tried to force its way through would be torn apart by the folds. But at this moment, in the center of the barrier, in the center of the badge pattern, there was a faint blue light flashing, like a distress signal sent by a drowning person on the water.
The light was very strange. It did not belong to any kind of elemental magic, nor did it look like a phantom created by illusion. It was beating slowly, rhythmically, like some kind of breathing.
Lin Che tried to stretch out her hand, and just when her fingertips were about to touch the barrier, she suddenly heard footsteps coming from behind.
"New student? This is not the place you should come."
A cold female voice sounded. Lin Che turned around and saw a girl wearing Jing Huan Kingdom costume standing not far away. Her hair was very light silver, her eyes were crystal clear ice blue, and she was holding a book with a cover as smooth as a mirror in her hand. It's Tsukihime, the orphan girl who is said to be able to see fragments of the future in the mirror.
"Just passing by." Lin Che retracted her hand and took half a step back calmly.
Yue Ji did not leave, however. She looked past Lin Che and landed on the wall of the restricted book area, her ice blue pupils shrinking slightly. "Did you see it too?" she asked softly.
"What did you see?"
"Light." Yue Ji's voice was very low, "The light inside the wall."
Lin Che's heart was shocked. He originally thought that this "spatial perception" was unique to him, but he didn't expect that Yue Ji could also see it.
"Can you see it?"
Yue Ji nodded and walked to him, her eyes fixed on the badge pattern on the wall. "It is recorded in the ancient books of Mirror Fantasy Academy that the 'door' is sealed in the forbidden book area of Fantasy Academy, and the key to open the door is hidden in the center where the school badge is missing." She raised her hand and drew a pattern in the air with her fingertips that was the same as the badge on the wall. "I saw the scene here in the mirror in the dormitory last night. It is exactly the same as now - except for that light."
"The picture in the mirror?"
"Well," Yue Ji's eyelashes trembled, "In the picture, this wall is open, and there is a spiral staircase inside. There is a glowing box at the end of the stairs. But the picture is very blurry, and mixed with... the sound of burning flames."
Flame? Lin Che immediately thought of Kai, the boy from the Magic Kingdom who always loved to compete with others in fire magic. Yesterday at the opening ceremony, Kai almost lit it with flames in order to show off his strength.
title_en: Chapter 5: The Emblem of the Restricted Area of ​​the Library Chapter 6: The Secret of the Space Perceiver
